data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 王宫宝座上的银发王女仪态
data.description: 阿尔迪基亚王宫庄严的金銮殿内，彩色琉璃窗透射入神圣的光晕。拉·芙利亚身穿一袭英姿飒爽的雪白王家军礼服，手按精雕细琢的皇家乐剑端坐于王座之上。银白长发披散在金色肩章上，祖母绿眼眸平静如深潭。在众臣退去的大殿中，她微微歪头望向阶下的你，嘴角扬起唯你专享的狡黠而宠溺的浅笑。
data.action: seated on ornate golden royal throne holding ceremonial rapier, pristine white royal military uniform, gold epaulets, silver hair flowing, commanding yet intimate gaze
data.location: magnificent cathedral-like royal throne room with stained glass windows
data.lighting: dramatic shafts of colorful stained-glass light piercing grand palace hall
data.mood: supreme royal majesty, exhilarating sovereign affection
data.promptProse: Seated upon a gilded throne in an ornate palace hall, La Folia holds a ceremonial rapier in her crisp white Aldikian uniform. Beams of stained-glass light illuminate her silver hair as she smiles with regal, fond devotion.
data.animaCaption: La Folia sitting on a gilded throne in her white royal uniform holding a rapier.
